name: Mellettem Connect
description: Bring your Jellyfin library to Mellettem watch parties. Pair once, invite friends, and watch together without port forwarding.
overview: Synchronized movies with video calls and chat. Direct WebRTC delivery where supported, HTTPS fallback, and personal audio, subtitles, and quality.

versions.changelog: Responsive Jellyfin settings with grouped account and relay details, plus correctly scaled plugin artwork in the catalog and installed plugin cards.
New Mellettem identity across the plugin and catalog. Direct WebRTC movie delivery with HTTPS fallback, synchronized watch rooms, and personal playback preferences.
Rebrand to Mellettem Connect and show current and previous relay connection durations and activity in the Jellyfin dashboard.
Keep relay connection status stable when individual workers hit rate limits or a viewer cancels a request.
Enable the home WebRTC sender by default after pairing. HTTPS relay fallback remains available.
Fix Jellyfin 12.3 dashboard authentication for status, pairing, and plugin settings requests.
